social_activities: For over a decade, I have been playing a decisive role in a variety of socio-cultural causes for the enrichment in the Davanagere region. As a Governing Council Member of BEA, I have been instrumental in initiating and supporting scores of cultural activities that celebrate and preserve the rich heritage of Davanagere. Under my guidance, BEA has become a vibrant hub for cultural exchange, hosting numerous events that celebrate the vivacity of traditional arts, music, dance, and fine theatre. These events not only provide a platform for local artists to showcase their talents and help the next generation nurture the arts and claim it as our cultural custodians. It is my dedication to cultural activities which has deeply rooted in my belief that arts and culture are pivotal in building a cohesive and vibrant community. My initiatives have revitalized the cultural landscape of Davanagere, making it a beacon of artistic expression in Karnataka. By organizing annual cultural festivals, workshops, and competitions, I have ensured that the cultural heritage of the region is celebrated and passed on to future generations. I have established the women's wing within our Bapuji Association, addressing gender-specific issues and empowering women through education and skill development programs. I believe my journey is a strong example of dedication to social causes and cultural enrichment leading to transforming a community. All my efforts through Bapuji Educational Association continue to inspire and uplift the people of Davanagere.

hobbies:
I enjoy reading books in general, autobiographies in particular. Critical analyses of literature and different perspectives never fail to catch my attention. I also prefer to read spiritual and motivational literature at times, which provide me with inspiration and inner strength. I update myself regularly on critical insights into health initiatives, lifestyles, and emerging trends. This passion for continuous learning and staying informed reflects my commitment to both personal growth and professional excellence, enabling me to effectively address the evolving needs of her community through informed and innovative approaches. I love to spend time amidst people doing my health-focused philanthropic activities most of the time. 
As for the family time, which is the most preferred mode of recreation for me, I love to spend quality time with my husband Sri S S Mallikarjun and my children- Mr. Samarth, Ms. Shrestha, and Mr. Shiva, often engaging in puzzle-solving activities with them. This cherished family time not only strengthens our bond but also fosters critical thinking and problem-solving skills in my children.
